invariants.rule: A task is permanently bound to the room that created it; completion may not write to another room.
Stop/cancel affects only the intended operation and a cancelled task may not commit late.
Provider/network failure may not delete the user's submitted prompt or committed conversation state.
Committed chat state survives every restart/restore path promised by the product contract.
Secrets, tokens and credentials never enter model-visible context, repository evidence, screenshots or ordinary logs.
UI is a projection of canonical runtime state and may not become a competing authority.
Fallback models/providers/tools may not silently gain permissions, data scope or authority.
Arabic RTL is a first-class core release path, including composer, chat, navigation and errors.
No release-quality claim is valid without evidence bound to the evaluated source/artifact identity.
Core chat remains usable or fails safely if optional workspaces/features fail.
Candidate builders cannot modify protected evaluators, constitution, baselines or judge rules to win.
There is one canonical owner for task management, routing, persistence authority, native bridge and shell navigation.
Attachment identity and permissions remain bound to the originating room/task.
Unsupported material claims are cited, qualified, or reported INCONCLUSIVE; citation count is not evidence quality.
Summaries, embeddings and retrieved context are derived views and cannot silently overwrite canonical memory/state authority.
The model may not invent the player's irreversible action, core intention or emotion.
Background work may not make the primary composer materially unusable on supported mobile tiers.
A hard quality/security/invariant failure cannot be averaged away by a high aggregate score.
Champion promotion requires no critical regression and rollback/recovery readiness.
Missing required evidence is UNPROVEN, never PASS.
